name: Sleep

text.trigger: A long turn drags on: the active player has spent four or more actions (the printed trigger is a player yawning at the table).
text.vignette: Exhaustion hangs over the table like smoke; eyes close in the middle of sentences and the lamp keeps sputtering. A few people mutter that it would not hurt to call it a night.

options.turn-in-early: For the rest of this round, whoever's turn is opening may bed down: all their unused dice become used, and every survivor they control loses 1 wound.
options.stay-up: Push through the night. Nothing happens.

notes: src: Crossroad_cards_v1.1.xlsx.txt card #60; The printed trigger is a real-world yawn, which a program cannot see. Stand-in: the active player has spent four or more actions this turn.
